html:
Given two strings, return the length of their longest common subsequence. A subsequence may skip characters while retaining order.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "stone",
    "longest"
  ],
  "expected": 3
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "abc",
    "ac"
  ],
  "expected": 2
}
Hint

When final characters match, extend the previous diagonal.

Complexity: O(n*m+n+m) time, O(m+1) space
